roles._layout: Main bars arranged in 4 cycles @600 (CYCLE-1, CYCLE-2,4, CYCLE-3 = mirror of CYCLE-1), so a bar used in two cycles has 3.33 pcs/m; combined main-bar spacing 150 on outer faces. Left/right = as drawn in CYCLE-1.
roles.T1: top slab outer (upper) face, left piece, bent down into left side-wall outer face (CYCLE-1; right piece in mirrored CYCLE-3)
roles.T2: top slab outer face, middle piece over the middle wall, lapped with T1/T3 (CYCLE-1,3)
roles.T3: top slab outer face, right piece, bent down into right side-wall outer face (CYCLE-1; left in CYCLE-3)
roles.T4: top slab inner (lower) face, continuous full-width bar, ends bent into side walls (CYCLE-1,3)
roles.T5: top slab outer face, left end piece bent down into left wall outer face (CYCLE-2,4; short corner bar)
roles.T6: top slab outer face, middle piece over the middle wall (CYCLE-2,4)
roles.T7: top slab outer face, right end piece bent down into right wall outer face (CYCLE-2,4)
roles.T8: top slab inner (lower) face bar between the outer haunches (CYCLE-2,4)
roles.B1: bottom slab inner (upper) face, continuous full-width bar, ends bent up into side walls (CYCLE-1,3)
roles.B2: bottom slab outer (lower) face, left piece, bent up into left side-wall outer face (CYCLE-1; right in CYCLE-3)
roles.B3: bottom slab outer face, middle piece under the middle wall, lapped with B2/B4 (CYCLE-1,3)
roles.B4: bottom slab outer face, right piece, bent up into right side-wall outer face (CYCLE-1; left in CYCLE-3)
roles.B6: bottom slab outer face, left end piece bent up into left wall outer face (CYCLE-2,4)
roles.B7: bottom slab outer face, middle piece under the middle wall (CYCLE-2,4)
roles.B8: bottom slab outer face, right end piece bent up into right wall outer face (CYCLE-2,4)
roles.W1: left side wall inner face vertical bar (CYCLE-1,3; @300 inner face)
roles.W2: right side wall inner face vertical bar (CYCLE-1,3)
roles.O1: middle wall (내벽) vertical bar, both faces (6.67/m = @150 per face)
roles.R1: outer-corner diagonal bar (135-degree legs). P2-1..P2-6: the only R mark, at the bottom outer corners. P2-7..P2-25, P2-27..P2-30, P2-32, P2-33: R1 = TOP outer corner bar (side wall/top slab) while R2 = bottom outer corner bar. P2-26, P2-31, P2-34, P2-35: again only R1, at the bottom outer corner
roles.H1: haunch bar at the top outer corners (side wall/top slab), diagonal a with 135-degree hooks b=100
roles.H2: haunch bar at the top corners beside the middle wall
roles.H3: diagonal corner bar at the bottom inner corners of the side walls (no haunch)
roles.H4: diagonal corner bar at the bottom corners beside the middle wall (no haunch)
roles.D1: top slab distribution (longitudinal) bars, both faces
roles.D2: bottom slab distribution bars, both faces
roles.D3: side wall distribution bars, both faces
roles.D4: middle wall distribution bars, both faces
roles.S1: top slab shear/tie bar (hooked stirrup tie)
roles.S4: middle wall tie bar (U/hooked tie, a=626 b=226 c=100 in P2-1)
roles.R2: bottom outer corner diagonal bar (side wall/bottom slab), present from P2-7 on whenever R1 is used for the top corners; often the largest diameter (H19..H29)
roles._markChanges: Same mark set (B1-B8, T1-T8, W1, W2, O1, H1-H4, D1-D4, S1-S4) in all 35 drawings; only R1/R2 usage varies as described under R1. Diameters per mark change between drawings (see bars). Main-bar count per m is 3.33 (@150) in P2-1, P2-2 and 4 (@125) from P2-3 on; 할증 (lap/waste allowance) is 3% for H13-H19 and 6% for H22 and larger.
